d: In an unprecedented diplomatic gathering, Chinese President Xi Jinping, Russian President Vladimir Putin, and U.S. President Donald Trump held their first-ever trilateral summit in Shenzhen on November 19, 2026. Opening the talks, Xi called on the three nations to take history as a mirror and promote peaceful coexistence. Putin highlighted the shared responsibility of the three permanent UN Security Council members in maintaining global stability, food and energy security, and resolving the conflict in Ukraine—noting he had already discussed the issue extensively with both Xi and Trump.…
